threads_note: The thread count p of a configuration is the number of worker threads of the pool created by the kernel (ExecutorService or ForkJoinPool); the main thread only waits. The JVM additionally runs internal threads (JIT compilers, SerialGC = 1 GC thread, housekeeping); their peak number is recorded per run (jvm_peak_thread_count). No numerical library with its own thread pool is used, and the common ForkJoinPool is not used.
affinity_note: No CPU affinity / pinning: macOS does not let user programs bind threads to cores, so the OS scheduler places them freely.
